content.summary: Twelve separate accounts each transferred amounts just under the $10,000 reporting threshold into ACCT-9000 within a 48-hour window, then the consolidated balance was moved out to an external account the same day. This pattern is consistent with structuring/smurfing followed by rapid layering.

claims.statement: ACCT-1001 through ACCT-1012 each sent between $9,200 and $9,800 to ACCT-9000, all just under the $10,000 CTR threshold.
All twelve inbound transfers occurred within a 48-hour window on 2026-07-10 and 2026-07-11.
ACCT-9000 had no prior transaction history before this cluster, then moved the full consolidated balance ($112,400) to an external account within hours of the last inbound transfer.
